I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message: there's no confirmed deadline for the signed order form at Tansley Parcel yet.

The only record is Pree's message in #central-team on 14 October, which says 25 August with no year. That date had already passed when she posted, so I asked her whether she meant 2027 or whether the deadline was missed. She hasn't answered in that thread. I also couldn't find any Tansley Parcel files in the share to check the date against.

I suggested Hollis check with Pree before putting the date in the account sheet.
